item.text: I’ll trace the project and issue service entry points, then apply the visibility check at reads, writes, and list queries so hidden private projects consistently surface as not found.

The service layer is the right enforcement point: each issue/comment path can resolve its parent project before authorization, and list totals need filtering before pagination/counting. I’m checking the actor shape and repository query APIs now.
